activities.title: Monsoon Campus Tree Plantation Drive
activities.location: North Campus Green Belt (Near Sports Pavilion)
activities.description: Join faculty, green club members, and fellow students to plant 200 native saplings. Gloves, trowels, compost, and sapling tree guards are provided.
activities.organizer: Campus Eco-Club & Dept of Environmental Studies

activities.title: Campus & Perimeter Zero-Waste Plogging Run
activities.location: Starts at University Main Gate Fountain
activities.description: Combine fitness and campus stewardship! We run, jog, and walk while collecting stray plastics and sorting them into recyclable bags. Refreshments served.

activities.title: Autumn Electronics & E-Waste Drop Day
activities.description: Bring dead laptop chargers, batteries, discarded wires, broken earphones, and old devices. Certified recyclers ensure non-polluting circular extraction.
activities.organizer: IEEE Student Branch & Campus Sustainability Office

activities.title: Hands-On Organic Composting & Soil Science Workshop
activities.description: Learn the exact science of carbon-to-nitrogen ratios, aeration, and moisture control. Take home a sample of rich organic compost for your dorm plants!

activities.title: Campus Watershed & Rainwater Cistern Inspection Walk
activities.description: An interactive technical tour of our 450,000-litre filtration tanks, bioswales, and recharge wells led by Civil Engineering professors.

activities.title: Green Commuter Cycling Rally & Bike Safety Clinic
activities.description: Celebrate clean campus mobility! Enjoy a 5 km campus group ride followed by free bicycle brake adjustments, chain lubing, and helmet checks.

ideas.title: Smart Solar-Powered Mobile Charging Benches
ideas.description: Install 6 weather-proof outdoor study benches with integrated photovoltaic canopies and USB charging ports in the central lawn to encourage outdoor studying without drawing grid power.
ideas.expectedBenefit: Generates estimated 2.4 kWh daily clean electricity while reducing indoor library overcrowding.

ideas.title: Greywater Recycling for Mechanical Workshop Coolants
ideas.description: Filter treated air conditioning condensate and dormitory greywater through sand bed filters to supply water for landscaping and machinery cooling.
ideas.expectedBenefit: Could conserve up to 8,000 litres of clean potable water every working week.

ideas.title: Campus Food Surplus Redistribution Shelf
ideas.description: Create a monitored temperature-controlled food pantry where unserved bakery items and pre-packaged cafeteria snacks are made available for late-night student study groups rather than being discarded.
ideas.expectedBenefit: Zero edible food waste while supporting students studying during midterms.

ideas.title: Dormitory Clothes Swapping & Second-Hand Book Kiosk
ideas.description: Set up an ongoing physical and digital barter kiosk during end-of-semester move-outs to prevent textbooks, lamps, and clothing from ending up in dumpsters.
ideas.expectedBenefit: Promotes circular economy culture and saves students money on academic supplies.

contributions.title: Planted 5 Neem & Jamun saplings in North Quad
contributions.description: Successfully prepped soil pits, mixed vermicompost, and planted 5 indigenous saplings with bamboo protective guards along the jogging path.

contributions.title: Recovered 14 legacy power supplies & 8 kg computer cables
contributions.description: Collected discarded peripherals from the second-floor hardware laboratory and segregated lithium battery packs from general circuit boards.

contributions.title: Cleared 6 kg single-use packaging around lake perimeter
contributions.description: Formed a 4-person team during Wednesday plogging and cleared plastic bottle caps, snack wrappers, and beverage cartons from the stormwater culvert.
